action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy allows exchange of delivered order items for available variants of the same product with user confirmation and payment method for price difference.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User confirmed exchange of wireless earbuds for a specific available variant, agreed to pay the price difference via PayPal, and confirmed no other items to exchange.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The user was authenticated, the order was delivered, the requested exchange was for a different variant of the same product, the new item was available, the price difference was calculated and presented, the user confirmed the details and payment method, and only one tool call was made in the turn.
